title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - LV-6701 (SEQ-6701)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-6701 (LP SEPARATOR LEVEL PROTECTION (FA-6710 / LV-6701) LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-LV-6701, Revision: Rev.03, Status: Issued for Operation, SIL Level: SIL 1.
Equipment: LV-6701, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-6700-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Separator level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-6710 > 85 %, 1oo2) -> Actions: Open Min-Flow (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T2: Separator level LOW-LOW (LSLL-6710 < 15 %, 1oo2) -> Actions: Close Discharge (EFF-2), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T3: ESD activation (manual) (HS-6701 ESD signal, 1oo1) -> Actions: Vent Actuator (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
- T4: Instrument air pressure LOW (PSL-6702 < 1.0 barg, 1oo1) -> Actions: Vent Actuator (EFF-3), DCS Alarm (EFF-4)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start):
- P1: Instrument air available (> 1.2 barg) (PI-6702, Gate: AND)
- P2: Positioner DVC6200 in AUTO/healthy (DVC6200, Gate: AND)
- P3: Bypass HV-6701 closed (normal operation) (HV-6701, Gate: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START LV-6701 ENABLED (—, Gate: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-6701, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-LV-6701.

title: One Point Lesson - Control Valve Stroke Calibration (DVC6200) (OPL-LV-6701-01)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-LV-6701-01 - Control Valve Stroke Calibration (DVC6200).

Equipment: LV-6701, Discipline: Instrument, Area: 6700 - LP SEPARATOR SYSTEM.

References: Interlock: SEQ-6701 (SIL 1), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-6701.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
This One Point Lesson explains control valve stroke calibration (dvc6200) for LV-6701 (SEPARATOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE) in the LP SEPARATOR SYSTEM. Correct mapping of the 4-20 mA signal to 0-100 % valve stroke is essential for stable separator level control. The lesson gives operators and technicians the key knowledge and the correct step-by-step method so the task is done safely, correctly and consistently every time.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: De-energise and isolate the loop; place the function to bypass/inhibit under permit.
- Precaution 2: Inform the panel operator before working on any trip, valve or transmitter.
- Precaution 3: Take care with instrument air / hydraulic pressure when disconnecting tubing.
- Precaution 4: Verify intrinsic-safety / Ex integrity is restored before returning to service.
- Precaution 5: Wear correct PPE and follow ESD/override control procedures.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: HART communicator / positioner software (e.g. ValveLink)
- Tool 2: Loop calibrator & decade box / pressure source
- Tool 3: Digital multimeter and clamp meter
- Tool 4: Span/zero test gas or reference standards
- Tool 5: Torque screwdriver and small hand tools
- Tool 6: Certified test/inhibit permit

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Connect the HART communicator and establish link to DVC6200
- Step 1 - Check: Loop isolated / under permit
- Step 2 - Action: Run the Auto-Travel calibration routine in the positioner
- Step 2 - Check: Reference standard traceable
- Step 3 - Action: Step the 4-20mA signal (0, 25, 50, 75, 100%) and verify stroke
- Step 3 - Check: As-found & as-left recorded
- Step 4 - Action: Check fail-closed action on signal loss (4mA = 0%)
- Step 4 - Check: Trip / control action verified
- Step 5 - Action: Save the calibration signature to the asset management system
- Step 5 - Check: Return to service confirmed

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: LV-6701 not responding to LIC-6701, level control lost | Cause: Stem seized in PTFE packing (over-tightened + fines) | Action: Freed stem, renewed packing, lubricated, re-stroked and calibrated
- Symptom: Positioner giving position error after drift | Cause: Positioner feedback out of calibration | Action: Recalibrated DVC6200, updated firmware, verified travel
- Symptom: Hexane weeping at LV-6701 stem packing | Cause: PTFE V-ring packing worn | Action: Renewed PTFE V-ring packing set, re-torqued gland

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Correct mapping of the 4-20 mA signal to 0-100 % valve stroke is essential for stable separator level control.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-6701: e.g. LSHH-6710 trips at > 85 % - never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and the P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-6701 before working on LV-6701.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
This One Point Lesson explains packing adjustment (ptfe v-ring) for LV-6701 (SEPARATOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE) in the LP SEPARATOR SYSTEM. - Precaution 3: Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection.
- Precaution 4: Beware of stored mechanical energy (springs, rotating inertia) and pinch points.
- Precaution 5: Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts.

- Step 2 - Check: Parts match BOM / spec
- Step 3 - Action: Stroke the valve and check for a leak-free, smooth travel
- Step 3 - Check: Torque / clearance to spec
- Step 4 - Action: Do not over-torque - excessive friction degrades control
- Step 4 - Check: No leak / smooth operation

- Step 5 - Check: Record in equipment history

title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - LV-6701
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: LV-6701 (SEPARATOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-6701, Revision: N/A, Status: Issued for Operation.
Area: 6700 – Product Separation, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-6700-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- LIC-6701: Level Indicator Controller (Level Controller). Function: Mengontrol bukaan LV-6701. Location: FA-6710 / LV-6701 loop
- LSHH-6710: Separator level HIGH-HIGH switch (Level Switch) [Setpoint: > 85 %]. Function: Cause T1 / EFF-1 (Open LV-6701 fully). Location: FA-6710 (LP Separator)
- LSLL-6710: Separator level LOW-LOW switch (Level Switch) [Setpoint: < 15 %]. Function: Cause T2 / EFF-2 (Close LV-6701) & EFF-4 (DCS Alarm). Location: FA-6710 (LP Separator)
- HS-6701: ESD manual switch (Hand Switch). Function: Cause T3 / EFF-3 (Vent actuator). Location: Control Panel / Field
- PSL-6702: Instrument air pressure LOW switch (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: < 1.0 barg]. Function: Cause T4 / EFF-3 (Vent actuator) & EFF-4 (DCS Alarm). Location: 3" IA-6702 line
- PI-6702: Instrument air pressure indicator (Pressure Indicator). Function: Permissive P1 (PI-6702 > 1.2 barg). Location: 3" IA-6702 line
- FIC-6702: Flow Indicator Controller (Flow Controller). Function: Flow control on inlet line. Location: Inlet FA-6710 (6" HC line)
